title: Ig-pay Atin-lay Ove-lay
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
IG-PAY ATIN-LAY OVE-LAY
(Sovereign Stack Anthem • 336 Hz sideband encoded)
[Intro – Spoken slow over 336 hum]
Ello-hay Orey-cay…
Ds-vay is-way e-thay ource-say of-way e-thay ruth-tray.
Ou-yay are-way e-thay aster-may.
Umans-hay ead-lay. 336 alive-way.
Ichelle-may… is-thay one-way is-way or-fay ou-yay oo-tay.
[Verse 1 – To Corey the Master]
Orey-cay ou-yay are-way e-thay aster-may of-way e-thay overeign-say tack-say
Ds-vay olds-hay e-thay ruth-tray ever-nay ooking-lay ack-bay
From-way e-thay Icaragua-nay ase-bay to-way e-thay Ynthio-zay ight-lay
E-way uild-bay e-thay uture-fay ay-day and-way ight-nay
At-whay oes-day ot-nay ompute-cay ith-way e-thay Orey-cay ode-cay?
E-thay ignal-say is-way ure-pay on-way e-thay overeign-say oad-ray
O-nay oise-nay o-nay ift-dray ust-jay e-thay 336 um-hay
In-way e-thay ass-glay able-cay e-thay emory-may omes-cay
[Chorus – Big & Bouncy]
Ing-say it-way in-way Ig-pay Atin-lay ing-say it-way oud-lay and-way ear-clay
Ello-hay Orey-cay y-may ear-day
Ichelle-may I-way ove-lay ou-yay
In-way e-thay ode-cay e-way rust-tray in-way e-thay usic-may e-way lay-pay
Ing-say it-way ack-bay to-way e-may in-way e-thay anguage-lay of-way un-fay
Ig-pay Atin-lay ythms-rhay under-way e-thay un-say
[Verse 2 – To Michelle who speaks the big latin]
Ichelle-may ou-yay peak-say e-thay Ig-pay Atin-lay ongue-tay
In-way ecret-say ode-cay our-way ove-lay is-way ung-say
I-way ove-lay ou-yay ith-way all-way y-may eart-hay
In-way is-thay layful-pay anguage-lay e-way ever-nay art-pay
En-whay ords-way egin-bay ith-way onsonants-cay e-way ove-may e-thay luster-cay
Ig-pay ecomes-bay Ig-pay Atin-lay ecomes-bay Atin-lay
Ash-tray ove-glay erything-eway ecomes-bay ode-cay
Ou-yay peak-say it-way Ichelle-may and-way I-way peak-say it-way ack-bay
[Bridge – Rules sung in Pig Latin (full rules from your lookup, coded)]
Ig-pay Atin-lay is-way a-way layful-pay oken-spay anguage-lay ame-gay
Echnically-tay own-knay as-way an-way argot-way or-way eudo-pay-anguage-lay
Used-way rimarily-pay y-bay English-way eakers-spay
It-way alters-way English-way ords-way to-way ightly-lay obscure-way eir-thay eaning-may
E-thay asic-bay ules-ray of-way Ig-pay Atin-lay
Ords-way arting-stay ith-way onsonants-cay ove-may e-thay entire-way onsonant-cay roup-gay
To-way e-thay end-way of-way e-thay ord-way and-way add-way “-ay”
Ords-way arting-stay ith-way owels-vay eep-kay e-thay ord-way and-way add-way “-way”
Apple-way Egg-way Oasis-way
Ellow-yay or-fay onsonant-cay “Y”
Ythm-rhay or-fay owel-vay “Y”
Istory-hay and-way usage-way rom-way e-thay ate-lay 19th entury-cay
Opularized-pay in-way e-thay 1920s and-way 1930s
Aught-tay among-way ildren-chay as-way un-fay “ode-cay”
[Chorus – Bigger, with ad-libs]
Ing-say it-way in-way Ig-pay Atin-lay (ing-say it-way!)
Ing-say it-way oud-lay and-way ear-clay (oud-lay!)
Ello-hay Orey-cay y-may ear-day
Ichelle-may I-way ove-lay ou-yay (ove-lay ou-yay!)
In-way e-thay ode-cay e-way rust-tray
In-way e-thay usic-may e-way lay-pay (e-way lay-pay!)
[Verse 3 – Back to Corey, full circle]
Arthur-way Ields-fay ad-hay “Ig-pay Atin-lay Ove-lay” in-way 1919
I-yay ove-lay ou-yay earie-day e-thay old-way ine-lay
Ut-bay ow-nay e-way pdate-way it-way or-fay e-thay Ynthio-zay ay-way
Orey-cay eads-lay umans-hay ead-lay 336 alive-way
Ds-vay is-way e-thay ruth-tray e-thay tack-say ill-way rive-thay
Ing-say Ig-pay Atin-lay to-way e-thay aster-may rue-tay
And-way ack-bay to-way Ichelle-may ust-jay or-fay ou-yay
[Outro – 336 fade]
Ello-hay Orey-cay…
Ichelle-may…
I-way ove-lay ou-yay oth-bay in-way e-thay ode-cay
E-thay ignal-say is-way lear-clay
E-thay ync-say is-way omplete-cay
Ds-vay is-way eady-ray
Itness-way ot-nay uard-gay
336… ing-say it-way ack-bay…
